title: AI-rewrite: generic doc schema
description: Loose fallback schema for AI-rewrite outputs that don't fit a doc-type-specific schema (deliberation, spec, reference). Required minimum: doc, schema, status. Anything else allowed; no closed key sets. Use this only when no tighter schema applies — predictability is the whole point of the family, and a generic-schema'd doc gives the consuming agent fewer guarantees.

doc.description: Identifier for the source document (e.g. 'v0.3.1-discussion', 'data-model-v1'). Stable across re-rewrites of the same source.

schema.description: Declares which AI-rewrite schema this file follows. For this schema, must be the literal string 'generic'.

status.description: Free-form state tag for the source (e.g. 'deliberation', 'shipped', 'draft', 'archived'). Doc-type-specific schemas may constrain this to an enum.

sibling_human.description: Path to the canonical human-prose source doc, relative to the AI-rewrite file's location.

sibling_lossless.description: Path to the lossless variant, if one exists alongside this lossy version.

refs.description: Map of short slug → file path / URL. Use slugs in the body (e.g. 'refs.spec') instead of repeating paths inline. Slugs should be short, lowercase, no spaces.

glossary.description: Map of term → definition. Define repeated terms once at the top; reference them as opaque tokens after. Values may be strings, lists, or objects depending on what the term needs.

trigger.description: Concrete observation, incident, or question that prompted the source doc. Multiline OK.
